goals: Verify that getSizes correctly parses single and multiple resolution options, handles defaults, and throws errors for malformed inputs.
Verify that getVariances correctly parses single and multiple variance options, handles defaults, and throws errors for invalid inputs.
activities: Call getSizes with no arguments and verify the result matches the snapshot
Call getVariances with no arguments and verify the result matches the snapshot
Call getSizes with a single resolution string and verify it returns the correct dimension object
Call getSizes with multiple resolution strings and verify it returns the correct array of dimension objects
Call getSizes with a malformed resolution string and verify it throws an error
Call getVariances with a single variance string and verify it returns the correct numeric array
Call getVariances with multiple variance strings and verify it returns the correct array of numbers
Call getVariances with a variance string greater than 1 and verify it throws an error
Call getVariances with a negative variance string and verify it throws an error
Call getVariances with a non-numeric variance string and verify it throws an error
